title: Foundational English: Letters and Sounds
subject: English Language and Literacy
content: Learning outcomes: recognize uppercase and lowercase letters A to F; connect each letter to its common beginning sound; match letters with familiar picture words; trace letters using age-appropriate strokes; speak one simple word for each letter. Examples: A for apple, B for ball, C for cat, D for dog, E for elephant, F for fish. Suggested homework: match six pictures to A-F, trace each letter once, circle the correct beginning letter, and say the picture words aloud. Assessment guidance: check recognition, sound matching, participation, and emerging pencil control. Accept age-appropriate letter reversals or uneven tracing as learning evidence and give gentle, encouraging feedback. Never compare children or judge ability, effort, or character.

title: Foundational Mathematics: Numbers 1 to 10
subject: Numeracy and Mathematical Thinking
content: Learning outcomes: recognize numerals 1 to 10; count concrete objects using one-to-one correspondence; match quantities to numerals; compare small groups using more, fewer, or same; identify circle, square, triangle, and rectangle in familiar objects. Suggested homework: count five groups of objects, circle the matching numeral, trace numbers 1 to 10, and match four shapes to objects found at home. Assessment guidance: check counting sequence, one-object-one-count behavior, numeral recognition, quantity matching, and shape identification. Treat reversed or uneven numeral writing as an age-appropriate learning step. Use simple language, praise specific correct actions, and provide one small next step.
